scope: SYNTHETIC_ONLY; design for future authorized official evidence

future_required_not_implemented: trusted timestamp and source authority receipt
independent latest inventory/rights trust anchor and signed completeness
crossissuer mapping with both native ID and validity interval
applicable official benchmark group and all seven gates
extraction parser version/normalizer and source literal

evidence_fields.root_rule: stable issuer/event/subject/historical_no/field, not increased by copies or versions; exact version/hash pointer distinguishes correction; dedup before use. Test code only finish_clock.
evidence_fields.field_status: Only a verified fictional positive integer clock in 0.1 s can be routed to RANK05; no analysis or rank output. Other observation types not available.

future_field_types.finish_clock: integer ticks 0.1 s and source literal
future_field_types.final3f: integer ticks 0.1 s separate from race final3f
future_field_types.race_lap: ordered race-leader interval lengths and time ticks, source layout; never individual sections
future_field_types.margin: typed unit, lengths vs time separate
future_field_types.identity: native issuer scoped IDs, independent crossissuer link
future_field_types.rights: per-field allowed purpose and latest registry version

status_semantics.TEST_INPUT_AVAILABLE: synthetic typed input, not item analyzed
status_semantics.MISSING: field unavailable, not zero or counter
status_semantics.HELD: packet withheld, no values, all115 held; reason preserved
status_semantics.future_REJECTED: structured malformed/source conflict, no numeric value, not poor performance; prototype uses HELD with reason
status_semantics.ANALYSIS_CONSUMED: requires downstream actual semantic trace; never true here

time_contract.race_asof: publication <= cutoff, sealed before conservative cutoff; pre-cutoff published correction unsealed => hold; after-cutoff correction not applied retroactively
time_contract.analysis_at: separate latest registry checked_at, rights evaluated again; historical observed <= enclosing capture_end
